description: This file defines a React functional component 'ExecutionIdentityPanel' for displaying detailed information about a specific workflow execution, including agent identity, verifiable credential status, and trust/security details. It manages state for UI interactions and performs actions like downloading VC bundles.

methods.name: truncateId
methods.description: Utility function to abbreviate an ID by slicing the first 8 characters and last 4 characters, separated by ellipsis.

methods.name: handleVerifyVC
methods.description: Function to handle VC verification action, currently toggles VC details view and logs the VC ID.

methods.name: handleDownloadBundle
methods.description: Asynchronous function to trigger download of the VC bundle for the given execution ID, manages download state and handles errors.
